verdict.rationale: The getting-started docs say findings can be routed to webhooks, so TruffleHog itself documents outbound webhook delivery of finding events. That support rests on a single thin mention. The custom-detector verification webhook is a different feature (an outbound verification call, not an event subscription), and Slack, Jira and email routing do not count toward this story. Missing for 10: documentation of webhook registration and configuration, event types and payload schema, delivery and retry or signing semantics, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Route findings to Slack, Jira, email, or webhooks so the right people can act on them.
